GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Tschüss" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. good day (daytime greeting)
   C. bye (friendly)
   D. please

2. What does "Gute Nacht" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. good night
   C. thank you
   D. bye (friendly)

3. The "ch" in "Nacht" is pronounced: (1 mark)
   A. like sh in ship
   B. as a breathy sound at the back of the mouth
   C. like ch in chair
   D. like k in kite

4. What does "montags" mean in the tongue twister about the mother? (1 mark)
   A. on Mondays
   B. every morning
   C. on Sundays
   D. tomorrow

5. What does "der Vater" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. friend
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. aunt
   D. father

6. What does "der Garten" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toilet
   B. sofa
   C. house
   D. garden

7. Which letter sounds like "ts" in "Zimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. sch
   B. z
   C. ch
   D. w

8. What does "immer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yesterday
   B. tomorrow
   C. always
   D. now

9. If today is Freitag, what is tomorrow? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Montag
   D. Sonntag

10. What does "Herzlichen Glückwunsch" express? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. I am hungry
   C. Congratulations
   D. Please

11. Which sentence says your age correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Ich bin zehn Kuchen.
   B. Ich heiße zehn.
   C. Ich habe heute zehn.
   D. Ich bin heute zehn.

12. What does "das Frühstück" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cabbage or kale
   B. juice
   C. breakfast
   D. sugar

13. What does "das Ei" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. fish
   C. sugar
   D. egg

14. What does "der Arm" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. nose
   B. finger
   C. neck
   D. arm

15. What does "der Hals" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. neck
   C. leg
   D. toe

16. What does "Was ist das?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Who is that?
   B. Where is that?
   C. What is that?
   D. How is that?

17. How is the word "heiß" pronounced? (1 mark)
   A. like hate
   B. like hoyss
   C. like hice
   D. like hiss

18. What does "Wie ist das Wetter?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is the weather like?
   B. Who is there?
   C. What time is it?
   D. Where is the house?

19. What does "singen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to drink
   B. to read
   C. to sing
   D. to hear

20. What does "trinken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to drink
   B. to sing
   C. to read
   D. to sleep

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word. (2 marks)

22. Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text. (2 marks)

23. Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German. (2 marks)

24. Write in German: "The sun is shining." (2 marks)

25. Write the German for: I cook, I sleep, I read, I play. (4 marks)

26. Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English. (2 marks)

27. List three members of the wider family in German with their articles. (3 marks)

28. Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand. (4 marks)

29. Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das. (4 marks)

30. Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink. (3 marks)

31. Write in German: "I have two ears." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — bye (friendly)
   Tschüss means bye (friendly).

2. B — good night
   Gute Nacht means good night.

3. B — as a breathy sound at the back of the mouth
   After a, o and u the ch is a scratchy breath sound at the back of the mouth.

4. A — on Mondays
   Montags means on Mondays, or every Monday.

5. D — father
   der Vater means father.

6. D — garden
   der Garten means garden.

7. B — z
   German z is pronounced ts.

8. C — always
   immer means always.

9. A — Samstag
   After Freitag comes Samstag.

10. C — Congratulations
   It is a warm congratulation or best wish.

11. D — Ich bin heute zehn.
   With age we use ich bin.

12. C — breakfast
   das Frühstück means breakfast.

13. D — egg
   das Ei means egg.

14. D — arm
   der Arm means arm.

15. B — neck
   der Hals means neck.

16. C — What is that?
   was means what.

17. C — like hice
   ei sounds like eye and ß is a strong s.

18. A — What is the weather like?
   das Wetter is the weather.

19. C — to sing
   singen means to sing.

20. A — to drink
   trinken means to drink.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Sonne scheint.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ich koche, ich schlafe, ich lese, ich spiele.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: die Oma, der Opa, der Onkel, die Tante.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ich habe zwei Ohren.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ich habe zwei and 1 mark for Ohren.
